notes.title: Dev Log
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

After three months of continuous development, we have completed 40 brand-new modules!

It’s important to note that the current version remains in the development phase, and the full release will still take some time. Progress has been relatively slow, as the current version is primarily developed by a single individual.

We would like to extend our heartfelt thanks for your long-term attention and support!

notes.title: Develop Plan
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, since the release of Idle Tower Defense, we have received a lot of encouragement, suggestions and criticism. Thank you all very much for playing.
I know Idle Tower Defense was not released as early access, but we will continue to update it with more content.
Thank you all for your support and understanding.

Here's our current development plan:
1. a new talent system.
2. more linkage between effects
3. some new modules
4. some new ascension effects
5. adjustments to existing modules and effects

notes.title: [v1.0.8] Update About Ascension
notes.notes:
Modules can now be permanently unlocked and upgraded at Ascension, and all skill points can be retained.
Also the [Damage Diamond] effect becomes a damage bonus, with all damage bonuses calculated in a separate multiplier zone.
The damage formula: Attack x (1 + Attack Bonus) x (1 + Damage Bonus)

notes.title: Idle Tower Defense Demo
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The demo of Idle Tower Defense has now been released. The demo includes 20 modules for you to play. Idle Tower Defense is still in development, and the demo does not contain all the content. If you encounter any issues or have any suggestions and feedback, please contact us.

notes.title: Idle Tower Defense Develop Plan
notes.notes:
Hi everyone！

We are very excited to release the store page, after months of hard work, Idle Tower Defense is in mid-development, and we are working towards releasing the demo, which is expected to be released in September. Also, we will join the Steam Next Festival.

If you are interested in our game, add to wishlist and look forward to it with us!
